title: Electric tube benders and wire benders

about_title: Servo-driven tube benders, from Ø15/32″ brake line to Ø6″ tube
about_text: CSM's electric benders put a servo motor on the bend arm — through CSM's patented transmission gears, to ±0.01° — and on the carriage, collet and tool shift. The EMB / EMR and MRE2-RBE are all-electric, with no hydraulic unit at all; the EMB / EMR switch between left- and right-hand bending within one part. The MBE / MRE and the TBRE / TMRE / TSRE / TDRE are electric hybrids with hydraulic clamp, pressure die and mandrel, one to three stacked tools, roll-bending heads and servo rear boosters, from Ø15/32″ fuel line to Ø6″. The WB 10-A and WB 14-A bend wire from the coil in 3D at up to 1,000°/s.

Chiao Sheng Machinery (CSM) has built tube benders in Tainan, Taiwan, since 1982 and released its first CNC bender in 1989; the company works from two plants in the Southern Taiwan Science Park, holds 24 international design patents, has been ISO 9001 certified since 2002 and CE-certifies every machine. NovoTech sells, installs and supports CSM machines in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada — layout for your building, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
